title: Warm Dutch Tomato Stew
description: A hearty and bitter Dutch stew featuring canned tomatoes, perfect for a hangover cure, made in a traditional cazuela vessel. This ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly dish is sure to satisfy your spring cravings.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the crushed canned tomatoes, brine pickle juice, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Add the water to the cazuela and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, allowing the stew to thicken slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the Warm Dutch Tomato Stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
